findings.source: RateLimiter._setTokenBucketConfig: s_bucket.tokens = uint128(_min(config.capacity, s_bucket.tokens)); s_bucket.isEnabled = config.isEnabled; s_bucket.capacity = config.capacity; s_bucket.rate = config.rate;
findings.issue: The field mask of the packed bucket slot, 0xffffffffffffffffffffff00ffffffff00000000000000000000000000000000 (keep lastUpdated, clear tokens and isEnabled), is factored as a pseudo-number times 3600 (P1), so this whole-slot write (P15) of tokens and isEnabled can't be read.
findings.rule: Never factor a constant used as an AND/OR mask (or whose hex form is runs of f and 0); better, split a masked whole-slot store into field stores (`uint128(stor3) = ...; stor3.field_160 = _param1`).

findings.issue: `timeDiff * rate` is distributed into two products (P9) both in the overflow check and in the refill, and the check repeats the dominating `lastUpdated != block.timestamp` condition (P11).
findings.rule: Keep products unexpanded; drop a conjunct already implied by the enclosing branch condition.
